Biome 2.5.7 replaces eslint+typescript-eslint+prettier (7 deps removed, 1 added). @types/uuid removed (v11 nonexistent, uuid@14 self-types). @octokit/auth-app added. engines.node>=20. biome.json created, eslint.config.mjs deleted. Verified: npm run build green, npm run lint runs (91 errors/1593 warnings to triage).

SECRETS_DIR now works: validation runs against resolved values (CLI flag -> SECRETS_DIR -> env) instead of raw process.env. Also fixed: --token CLI flag was equally broken (validateConfig(process.env) never saw it). Boolean/numeric getters now route through the resolver. z.coerce.boolean replaced with explicit booleanFlag ('false' no longer parses true). FileSecretProvider path-traversal guard. Logger redaction (ConsoleLogger + StructuredLogger) and GitHubConfig.token made non-enumerable. 26 new tests, all passing. Suite: 2204->2233 pass, 59->58 fail, no new failures. Smoke-verified: SECRETS_DIR-only boot reaches tool registration; no-creds still fails closed; CLI-flag-only boots.

hardStop now enforced. checkoutTask gates on AgentBudgetService.getBudgetStatus().isExhausted before claiming (AgentBudgetService injected as optional 5th ctor param). resolveBudgetOwner walks to the ROOT with a visited-set cycle guard + MAX_AGENT_HIERARCHY_DEPTH, so a grandchild debits the root not its parent. register_agent enforces MAX_AGENT_HIERARCHY_DEPTH=5 and MAX_AGENT_CHILDREN=20. CORRECTION: A5 was wrong - reclaimStaleTasks already probes registryExists() read-only and returns early (TaskCheckoutService.ts:569); the misleading env.ts comment was fixed instead. Server-side metering (A2) deferred to Phase 3 AI provider wrapper. 10 new tests; all 8 agent test files pass (70 tests).

All 4 direct process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN reads eliminated; requireToken()/resolveOwner()/resolveRepo() in tool-factory are now the single credential accessors, routed through the Phase-1 resolver. GhCliSecretProvider added as last link in the chain (execFileSync with arg array, 5s timeout, stderr discarded, failure-tolerant, cached once per process, opt out via GH_CLI_TOKEN_FALLBACK=false). GitHub App installation auth via @octokit/auth-app at the single Octokit construction site; App outranks PAT when all 3 vars present, partial config falls back rather than locking out. Deleted dead src/infrastructure/github/config.ts (token-leaking toJSON) - its two importers repointed to GitHubConfig.ts, removing the duplicate class - and scripts/get-github-token.js (undeclared axios/express deps). VERIFIED: real GitHub API call authenticated as kunwarVivek with zero explicit token config, via gh alone; opt-out fails closed. 6 new tests.

AI keys now reach the SDK: createAnthropic/createOpenAI/createGoogleGenerativeAI/createPerplexity built with the resolved key, replacing the default singletons that re-read process.env (so CLI-flag and SECRETS_DIR keys were silently ignored). Provider selection replaced with an explicit registry + AI_<ROLE>_PROVIDER override; an unrecognised model now errors instead of silently falling back to Anthropic AND substituting a different model string. Retired model defaults updated: claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022 (retired 2025-10-28, 404s) -> claude-opus-5 for main/prd, gpt-4o -> claude-sonnet-5 for fallback, perplexity-llama-3.1-sonar-large-128k-online -> sonar-pro. getConfiguration() redacts apiKey. 17 new tests.

Two stdout corruption sources fixed, not one. (1) GitHubSprintRepository.delete() console.log -> logger.warn. (2) NEW FIND, introduced by the dotenv 16->17 bump itself: dotenv v17 prints an 'injected env' banner to STDOUT ahead of the JSON-RPC response, breaking any MCP client - fixed with quiet:true. Added src/__tests__/e2e/stdout-purity.e2e.ts asserting every stdout line parses as JSON; verified it FAILS with the banner restored and passes with the fix. Deleted unused Pagination.ts and the dead .test.ts.new/.fixed/.bak files.

Migrated to @modelcontextprotocol/server v2. index.ts: McpServer + serveStdio (per-connection protocol negotiation) replaces Server + StdioServerTransport; 17 registerTool calls + one shared dispatchTool replace the single CallTool handler; both TS2589 'as any' casts gone. serverInfo.version now read from package.json (was hardcoded 0.1.0 vs 1.1.0); hand-rolled SUPPORTED/PREFERRED_PROTOCOL_VERSION constants deleted - negotiated 2025-06-18 at runtime. Tool execution failures now return {isError:true} instead of throwing a protocol error, so the model can see and recover. structuredContent only emitted when an outputSchema is declared. ToolValidator + ToolRegistry moved to ProtocolError/numeric codes. Removed @modelcontextprotocol/sdk and zod-to-json-schema deps.

CRITICAL FIND: zod-to-json-schema silently emits an EMPTY schema for zod 4 types - {type:'object'} with NO properties, no error. Since the zod 3->4 bump every one of the 17 tools advertised a parameterless input schema, so no MCP client could discover a single argument. Replaced with zod 4 native z.toJSONSchema({io:'input'}). Verified: 17/17 tools now expose full schemas (30/32/14/12 params), 0 empty, 17 annotated. Note CLAUDE.md's claim that zod-to-json-schema@3.25.2 supports zod 4 is empirically false.

Suite fully green: 2967 passed / 20 skipped / 0 failed across 118 files (was 59 failing in a suite that was hiding 544 tests). All 17 npm scripts rewritten from Jest-only flags to Vitest syntax, each verified to actually select tests. 5 production bugs fixed along the way: ESM require() in TaskContextGenerationService (broke parse_prd at runtime), listSprints('completed') could never match, getCurrentSprint ignored includeIssues, unguarded .map on partial LLM output, EnvSecretProvider capturing process.env by reference. Global fake-timer leak in vitest setupFiles scoped to e2e only.

Global fake-timer leak in vitest setupFiles scoped to e2e only.

Server-side metering implemented via ai-SDK middleware. wrapLanguageModel wraps every model returned by AIServiceFactory.getModel - the sole model construction site - so all 33 generateText/generateObject call sites across 22 files are metered with zero edits to them. Spend accumulates in AsyncLocalStorage (reusing the existing but previously-unwired CorrelationContext) and is debited ONCE per tool call in dispatchTool, not per AI call, because AgentStore is GitHub-backed and does unlocked read-modify-write. agentId added to aiGenerate/aiAnalyze/aiPlan schemas. No agent in context = no debit, no crash. 10 tests.

RCA CORRECTIONS (both found by testing, not assumed): (1) the flagged blocker - wrapLanguageModel assignability to LanguageModel - does NOT occur; the real issue was LanguageModel admitting the model-id string, fixed by typing off wrapLanguageModel's own parameter. (2) The RCA's usage shape was WRONG: ai@7 reports inputTokens/outputTokens as OBJECTS carrying .total, not numbers. Reading them as numbers yields NaN and silently poisons the budget. Guarded by test.

SCOPE LIMIT, stated honestly: this does NOT close the self-reporting loophole. It meters tokens THIS SERVER spends on an agent's behalf. Tokens the agent's own runtime spends never traverse this process and are unobservable by construction - closing that needs the agent's model traffic proxied through this server, a much larger change. record_usage remains the only channel for agent-side spend.

CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md brought in line with reality and re-synced (AGENTS.md had lost every hand-written section to 'bd setup codex'). Corrections: the false claim that zod-to-json-schema supports zod 4; Jest/--experimental-vm-modules replaced with Vitest 4 plus the two traps that cost real time (arrow-vs-new in mocks, implicit-return beforeEach treated as a teardown callback); Biome noted in the commands table; dev script noted as tsx. Added: MCP v2 architecture + isError vs protocol-error semantics + v2 pre-validating args before ToolValidator runs; the full GitHub credential chain incl. gh fallback and GitHub App; resolved-config-before-validation; log redaction; isolatedModules rules incl. decorated params; server-side metering scope; the ai@7 usage-shape trap.

Lint errors 34 -> 16 (all remaining are in scripts/ and examples/, not src/). Real fixes: 3 forEach callbacks given explicit no-return bodies; 7 implicit-any lets made explicit. Documented false positives with rationale: control-char regex in InputSanitizer (stripping control chars IS the function), assignment-in-condition for the canonical regex exec loop. Warnings 1611 -> 1132.

IMPORTANT config change: biome's lint/complexity/useArrowFunction is now OFF, with rationale in biome.json. Its autofix rewrites 'function () {...}' mocks to arrows; arrows are not constructible, and the code under test calls new - it silently broke ~90 tests.

Warnings 1611 -> 871, infos 151 -> 8, lint errors 34 -> 16 (none in src/). Six mechanical rules applied ONE AT A TIME with full typecheck + 2977-test verification after each. Dead code: 57 unused variables, 9 unused private members, 3 params removed and 25 _-prefixed (not deleted - removing a param shifts positional args). 12 unused catch bindings converted to optional catch binding. Suite unchanged at 2977 passing throughout. Remaining 582 warnings are noExplicitAny (421) + noNonNullAssertion (161) - a typing project, deliberately deferred; noExplicitAny is set to warn on purpose for MCP boundary adapters.

Review handoff and project-item binding fixed: submit_for_review clears the claim so the review queue is claimable, approve/reject release every holder, selectProjectItem binds claims/status to the requested project, direct assignment refuses issues outside the project, blocker parsing honors every reference, release_task surfaces project failures. Unit tests added and passing.

Registry and work-product storage hardened: malformed registry JSON and invalid records fail closed, canonical registry selection, cascade count fixed, work products paginated and schema-validated, project field inspection failures propagate, incompatible field types are a hard error, missing status options are added additively.

Compound MCP surface aligned: agent_work/agent_manage are action-discriminated unions with per-action required args, set_budget accepts warningThreshold as an alias of warningFraction, rebalance_workload reclaims and redistributes, converge_project settles through the normal approve/reject lifecycle and clears claim/status/agent state.

All 12 confirmed mismatches closed (G12-01..G12-12 in docs/remediation/GAP-TRACKER.md): the rule API replaced by the real ProjectV2Workflow, the view/field payload shapes fixed, the field-type set narrowed to the creatable one, the reviews paginated, the item field-value reader widened, the dead mappers deleted.

Tool schemas are now derived from the installed SDK (2.3.1 StandardSchemaWithJSON + Ajv validation, zod 4) and the agent tools advertise the hybrid schema (flat top-level properties for discovery plus a oneOf variant per action with that action's required arguments). The action sweep drives every advertised action.

multi_select is a first-class field type now: the domain type, the field creator (dataType + multiSelectOptions), the item value writer (multiSelectOptionIds) and the reader (ProjectV2MultiSelectFieldOption) all handle it; an option sent with its id keeps its identity.
ProjectTemplateService.updateProjectView now delegates to the repository, which sends UpdateProjectV2ViewInput correctly (viewId only, the layout enum board/table/roadmap).

Fixed: the registry is found by its title (the label query is a retried fallback for a renamed registry), duplicates are folded into the canonical issue with the last-written record winning, a corrupt body is left untouched so the read fails closed, and the reclaim sweep no longer creates the registry. Covered by unit tests (title lookup without the label filter, duplicate folding, the canonical selection).

Adopted: the native 'blocked by' edges (Issue.blockedBy / Issue.blocking) are read and written through addBlockedBy / removeBlockedBy, reachable via manage_issues/list_dependencies, add_blocker and remove_blocker. The label/body emulation stays the fallback, and the claim path honours the native edge.

Adopted: Issue.issueType is read and written (updateIssueIssueType) with the organization catalogue behind manage_issues/list_issue_types; a type outside the catalogue is written as the platform's type: label.
Adopted: the claim path reads the issue's project items with includeArchived: true and refuses a task that is already claimed on another board, so the same work is no longer handed out twice.

Adopted: manage_project/set_collaborators writes updateProjectV2Collaborators with the four live roles (ADMIN/WRITER/READER/NONE). GitHub exposes no role read, so the granted roles are what the call returns.

Adopted: manage_project/list_views returns the view's filter / groupByFields / sortBy / visibleFields, and agent_work/checkout_task accepts a view — the view's own order decides which task is handed out first.
